title: Gridiron Standard: 13-position current-primary research re-rank

calendar_context.primary_sample: REG weeks 1–8, all Week 9 games explicitly excluded
context_samples: Selected explicitly labeled REG pass-rush grades and article-specific subsets
calendar_context.current_data_consistency: Current 2026 public NFL weekly/NGS/PFR/ESPN evidence is available through Week 8, so 2025-only ordering was NOT used. PFF current snapshot explicit endpoint week filter is not exposed; Week-8 anchor grades and near-matching PFR snaps corroborate, not prove every row same sample.

ranking_methodology: Use current role/volume plus at least two complementary performance signals where available; grade evidence is not a score-conversion formula.
Passing EPA/CPOE, RYOE, target EPA/YACOE and tracking wins are model-conditioned on actual observed plays, not simulated box scores. Context/team/scheme can affect them.
2025 informs sustainability and role change only; it cannot replace missing established-season 2026 performance.
No team records, awards, contracts, reputation, EA ratings or lack of EA cards decide a ranking.
Broad bands are unresolved comparisons, not identical ability; listed name order inside a band has no ranking meaning. Cut-line bands can span more candidates than remaining slots.

Current-performance order is not a new healthy-ability/full-card order. Injured players with inadequate primary samples remain unranked/unvalidated, not declared inferior. Availability should not secretly depress every healthy-skill attribute.

Current MEDIUM research interpretations remain non-engine-eligible because the full category package is incomplete; no LOW-confidence comparison, prior_context-only claim or previous locked verdict is submitted as a fresh approved comparison.
Do not convert PFF 90 into GS OVR90 or infer power/speed from size. Preserve current GS full-card values unchanged.
global_missing_data_flags: PFF current passing/rushing/receiving/blocking/rush-defense facet grades mostly locked; public isolated facts are separately scoped.
PFF side/alignment/true-pass-set splits unavailable publicly in this pass; depth-chart majority is proxy, not measured snaps.
Week9 practice/medical volatile details not independently rechecked; no final approval requested or performed.
No fresh full-game film review; techniques and physical-attribute precision remain unverified.
Public individual ESPN tables truncated; absence from a leaderboard is unknown.
No final exact top10 for any position where ties cross cut line; FB complete reorder not established.
No new numeric OVR or attribute estimates supplied; existing full-card judgments have not been revalidated attribute by attribute.

metric_definitions.PBP_mean_cpoe: Mean completion probability over expectation, percentage points, on nonmissing CPOE pass records; denominator cpoe_n. This is not NGS CPOE.
metric_definitions.PBP_qb_dropbacks: qb_dropback=1, excluding deleted/no_play/kneeldowns; includes passing/sacks/scrambles, excludes designed QB runs; Allen rushing value considered separately.
metric_definitions.PBP_rush_success_rate: Fraction of rush records with success=1 (positive EPA), excluding kneeldowns; not a PFF success grade.
metric_definitions.NGS_week0: Provider season aggregate on eligible tracking plays, with 2026 weekly sample stopping at Week8. Modeled play denominators can differ from official stat attempts.
metric_definitions.PFF_qualifies: Provider public table Boolean (25%-snap filter); not a universal GS confidence certification.
metric_definitions.listed_size: Contemporaneous roster/provider LISTING, not a fresh measurement; no strength/speed deduction.

Drake Maye: 2025 REG overall 90.1 is NOT the 80.7 REG+POST overall. Postseason changed the sample substantially.
Zach Allen: Material 2025-source conflict: current PFF default table overall 63.1; preseason DI article says 76.6 for 2025. Keep all scopes/claims separate; no average or silent correction.
Christian McCaffrey: Use official 2025 REG 102 receptions/924 receiving yards, not a local PBP 904-yard subtotal or postseason-inclusive article total.
Darnell Washington: Listed-size conflict: current roster/team bio 6 ft 7 / 264 lb versus PFF article 6 ft 6 / 311 lb. Measurements are listed, not contemporaneously measured; physical-strength ratings not deduced from either weight.
Zach Bako-Bewele: Same player as historical Zach Tom; 2026 name change independently sourced. Stable ID preserves 2025 continuity.
Connor Heyward: 2025 PFF TE row is contextual, not a 2025 FB grade; 2026 FB row and depth-chart role verify current eligibility.
Juice Scruggs: 2025 PFF G row versus 2026 C row: position change, not a missing/zero 2025 center performance. Latest 2026 depth listings and article lineup may differ; verify starts before a final side/role decision.
Penei Sewell: 2025 RT to 2026 LT change is supported by the public 2026 tackle article and current depth charts.
Joe Alt: Current Week-8 PFF offensive-line article lists LT; aggregate 2026 depth-chart observations and the baseline assign RT. Preserve conflict rather than assuming all current snaps are RT.
Mason McCormick: Week-8 article lists LG; 2026 aggregate depth observations still favor RG. GS RG slot retained for scope, not asserted as every-game current alignment.
Ezra Cleveland: Latest public Week-8 lineup says RG; GS LG pool retained. 2026 depth records include both sides.
Quenton Nelson: Current team SEA differs from completed-2025 IND. The Nov-4 article lineup labels RG but prose implies Nelson LG/Zabel RG; depth records favor LG. Do not treat one internally inconsistent lineup bullet as true snap alignment.
Byron Young: ID resolves the Rams Tennessee-college edge, NOT the Eagles Alabama-college DT with the same name.
Lane Johnson: Local note says inactive/lacks EA card; current NFL roster says ACT. ACT is not gameday activation. Absence of an EA card is not a performance-based exclusion.
DJ Reader: Current 90.4 overall/23% ESPN PRWR versus only two PFR pressures: major metric-method divergence; no invented PFF pressure count, run-defense grade or inferred win-to-pressure conversion.
Abdul Carter: Near-even two-year depth-chart side majority; no public true snap-alignment split.
Josh Hines-Allen: Near-even two-year depth-chart side majority; no public true snap-alignment split.
Alijah Vera-Tucker: No 2025 NFL PFF G row in the downloaded sample; prior 2024 evidence is not silently relabeled 2025.
Michael Burton: 2025 injury/reserve absence does not invalidate his actual 2026 NFL FB sample.
Gabe Jacas: 2025 Illinois college context, not NFL production; actual 2026 NE EDGE sample recorded.
Max Bredeson: 2025 Michigan college context, not NFL production; actual 2026 MIN FB sample recorded.
DJ Herman: 2025 San Diego State college LB context, not NFL FB production; actual 2026 MIA FB sample recorded.

QB.proposed_order_scope: Relative order only among currently assessable candidates. Does NOT place injured/no-sample players below healthy players or approve a new full-card GS ability order. No ordering inside a rank band.
QB.rationale: Burrow combines 93.3 overall with +0.223 EPA/dropback and +8.98 CPOE. Allen stays above several higher-overall passers because 270 rushing yards and nine rushing TDs add independent current value. Purdy/Goff both approach +0.247 EPA/dropback. Prescott has the larger passing workload; Maye has stronger CPOE; Lamar has elite +0.356 EPA/dropback but only 102 recorded dropbacks. Lawrence stays competitive despite 72.3 overall because +0.282 EPA/dropback and 17:4 TD:INT are current signals. The crowded 9–15 boundary is genuinely unresolved without passing/pressure/TWP facets. Stafford’s 2025 MVP/91.7 passing grade cannot rescue his weaker current 66.8 overall/+0.062 EPA/dropback.

Watson’s 708 yards/six touchdowns and Burden’s post-catch value prevent grade-only exclusions; no bottom-tier cut-line winner is asserted.
